name: artisanpack-ui/ecommerce
description: Ecommerce package for the ArtisanPack UI ecosystem.

suggest.artisanpack-ui/cms-framework: Auto-registers admin nav entries and reuses cms auth/roles when present.
suggest.artisanpack-ui/visual-editor: Enables commerce blocks (product grid, single-product, add-to-cart, cart, checkout, price, gallery).
suggest.artisanpack-ui/media-library: Product images via media-library; falls back to a nullable image_url on ProductImage.
suggest.artisanpack-ui/forms: Enables product-inquiry and quote-request form field types and draft-order spawning from submissions.
suggest.artisanpack-ui/icons: Icon slot on product categories and kanban columns.
suggest.artisanpack-ui/accessibility: WCAG contrast checks for admin theme and cart/checkout color choices.
suggest.artisanpack-ui/livewire-ui-components: Required by the Livewire UI satellite packages that render engine data.
